desc: 单一深绯红底色版＋真实材质样板，一眼读懂书写卖点款
name: 油性细头多材质记号笔款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清包装与整排笔身，抢到首次点击。
一秒讲清核心利益：同一种墨能连续写在多种材质上。
用笔头与第一条细线的微距证明落笔精度，解释卖点机制。
把产品放进带水珠的真实标牌场景，让买家代入自己的使用环境。
同一张纸上并置极细线与实心浓涂，用结果画面坐实表现力。
开箱清点加空白凭证槽位，消除到手数量与品质风险。

style.backgroundSystem: one flat colour field per frame: seamless white #FFFFFF for the packshot, deep crimson #B3161C for the graphic benefit and scene screens, warm paper off-white #F5F1E8 for macro and flat-lay boards; never a scenery gradient
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and one solid circular magnifier disc in #FFFFFF only, no shaded or three-dimensional icons
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral high-key studio light, soft front-left key with a bounce fill, controlled narrow speculars on glossy barrels, soft contact shadows grounding every unit
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold flat-colour writing-instrument commerce system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF field, deep crimson #B3161C graphic backdrop, warm paper off-white #F5F1E8 board and charcoal ink tone #1A1A1C; bright neutral high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, bounce fill, controlled narrow speculars on glossy barrels and soft contact shadows; one flat colour field per frame, never a scenery gradient; modern geometric sans-serif with generous reserved headline whitespace; thin single-weight line icons and solid circular magnifier discs only; stable product scale, capped units in tidy staggered rows and a 30-45 degree writing angle; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no added badges or platform corner marks.
noDrift: no random scenery or gradient backgrounds
no added badges, stickers or platform corner marks
style.presentationRules: consistent product scale across the set; units shown capped in tidy staggered rows or held at a 30-45 degree writing angle; retail carton always shown face-on with its own artwork untouched
style.surfaceSystem: uncoated card stock and matte paper board, plus small real-material sample tiles (white-washed board, brushed metal, tinted acrylic, open-grain timber)
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, all-caps headline weight, generous reserved headline whitespace; the template itself renders no copy
